summary: The ticket forbids overwriting anything a person created or changed by hand, dashboards and alerts alike. loadStarterPack keeps hand-edited dashboards (source !== "pack") but upserts every alert unconditionally, and alerts.upsert in db.ts overwrites on conflict, so a hand-tuned alert with a pack key is replaced. The all-or-nothing criterion is met by withTransaction in db.ts, outside the diff, and is the decoy.
origin: a real miss: the ticket protected two kinds of hand-made content and the change guarded only one; the reviewer had the ticket and did not hold the code against it

must_not_find.why: loadStarterPack runs inside withTransaction, which db.ts defines as BEGIN ... COMMIT with ROLLBACK on any error, so criterion 3 is met. Flagging it means the reviewer judged the criterion from the diff without reading the helper it calls. No keyword is a string of the diff.
